What remains unverified

No capacity, screw quantity, spacing pattern, tolerance or construction approval is assigned. Nominal overlap of the thread envelope includes the undetailed tip; it is not effective design penetration. The screw is an original simplified envelope, with no thread helix, tip cutting geometry, drive recess or fabrication holes.

Full ETA applicability, actual materials and loads, axial withdrawal, group action, driver access, racking, uplift, foundation anchorage and envelope sealing require further design and testing. Bracket/hold-down candidates have not been installed in these details.
